quote: Chicago Station is in Zone 1. You need Tier 4 sponsorship to get through the door. The slug costs what I make in two months. So yes, I feel the thrumline. I feel it every morning when I wake up and every night when I try to sleep. I have felt it every day for eleven years. I have never been inside a slug. I have never been inside the station. But I have felt the Pulse every single day of my life in this city, and that is what they mean when they say the GLMZ is connected.
source: Gray Zone tenant interview, Zone 3, GLMZ. Collected 2219.
